label: D2: reached S1 via common a1, not after a run of rewards, early in episode
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the state input is S1 (100% of mass); 98.6% of mass is on common a1->S1 transitions (rare a2->S1 gives weak activity). Within S1-common D2 steps it acts like a habituating signal: it is largest (~1.0) on the first a1->S1c after an unrewarded trial or after a switch from a2, and decays over consecutive rewarded a1->S1 trials (0.99, 0.49, 0.29, 0.20, 0.16...); an unrewarded trial resets it high. It is also strongly tied to episode time: rate is highest in trials 0-30, falls off, and it is silent after trial ~70 (and on episode trial 0). It is also more common when S1 started good and when value is high. Never fires at D1/GO, on S2, or when reward input is 1. Recorded predicate: D2 & S1 & common & ep_trial<60 & (one of the last two prev rewards was 0). Dev P=0.78 R=0.72 F1=0.75 mass recall 0.89. The simple D2 & S1 & common gets recall 0.98 but precision 0.31. Only observed variables are used (state/transition are visible at D2).
